text:
Maria G: heads-up — tenant-77 restore hit a decrypt error during the maintenance window, failing with 'decrypt: CMK not found'. Anyone touched tenant CMKs overnight? :warning:
Samir: on it. can you paste the exact log line + snapshot id?
Maria G: snapshot id: snap-20260321-77. log:
```
2026-03-21T02:11:03Z restore: decrypt failed: KMS:KeyNotFound cmk=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/tenant-77-cmk operation=decrypt snapshot=snap-20260321-77
```
Jonas: we kicked the archive re-encrypt job last night for cross-region parity. it touched a subset of older snapshots. i remember a flag to drop SSE metadata for compatibility — could be that.
Anna (oncall): tagging security and encops. can someone check the KMS audit log for a deletion/disable event for tenant-77-cmk? also check IAM grants for the backup service account.
EncOps Bot: automated alert — KMS key "tenant-77-cmk" status changed to DISABLED by user:infra-ops@redwood.internal at 2026-03-21T01:42:11Z. Reference: https://encops.internal/logs/keys/tenant-77-cmk [bot message]
Samir: ok that's the culprit. looks like a staged key rotation but the new key wasn't applied to the snapshot metadata. quick mitigation: re-enable the old key temporarily or grant decrypt to the restore service using the new key alias.
Backup Bot: snapshot metadata for snap-20260321-77: [sse_mode: SSE-CHECKED, cmk_ref: tenant-77-cmk, region: us-west1, origin: nightly-archive].
Jonas: re-enable old key only if ops confirms no policy violation. rotation script probably removed the CMK ref after re-encrypt but the job failed mid-run for some shards.
Maria G: what's the smallest blast radius fix? we need this restore to finish for the customer (PII).
Samir: fastest path = re-enable the disabled CMK for 30m and run the restore. steps:
1) infra oncall re-enable key
2) run restore, confirm data integrity
3) follow-up: re-run re-encrypt job with strict metadata checks and dry-run first
Anna (oncall): i'll open a quick change to re-enable and ping sec for RBAC approval. tagging @Jonas for the re-encrypt dry-run afterwards.
Jonas: ack. i'll add extra assertions to the job: ensure cmk_ref present or fail before clearing. also add an `--atomic-metadata` flag to only commit on full-shard success.
EncOps Bot: recommended playbook: https://playbooks.internal/encryptops/restore-cmek-mismatch — includes steps for temporary grants and audit checklist.
Maria G: security note — if we temporarily re-enable a key or add a decrypt grant, make sure to document who approved and add an audit entry. we'll need that for compliance.
Samir: filed ENG-4529 with the rollback plan and short-term grant scope. will post updates here.
Anna (oncall): change approved by infra lead (Samir) in ticket, re-enabling key now. :thumbsup:
(5 minutes pass)
Samir: re-enable done, restore resumed, now at 72% tokenized shards. monitoring console shows no further decrypt errors.
Maria G: confirm restore succeeded. i'll run a quick verification against known checksums.
Jonas: follow-up tasks: 1) add metadata sanity checks to re-encrypt pipeline, 2) audit all CMK state changes in the last 7 days, 3) add unit/integration test to prevent metadata-drop.
Maria G: thanks team — i'll compile notes for compliance and attach to the ticket. closing thread once verification complete.
Anna (oncall): noted — adding postmortem stub to the ticket. please ping if anything else pops up.
EncOps Bot: reminder: record KMS approval entries in audit log and attach key-change justification to ENG-4529.
Maria G: will do.
